species.tagline: A living fossil of Hong Kong's mudflats

tasks.title: Find the shell and tail
tasks.hint: Find the head shield and the pointy tail spine
tasks.message: The horseshoe crab has a big head shield and a pointed tail.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a Chinese horseshoe crab. It has a big round shield and a long pointed tail.

tasks.title: Count its legs
tasks.hint: Turn it over to see how many legs
tasks.message: Under its shell, the horseshoe crab has many pairs of legs.
tasks.subtitle: Under the hard shell, the horseshoe crab has many pairs of legs for walking and finding food.

tasks.title: See the book gills
tasks.hint: Switch to X-ray to see the book gills
tasks.message: The book gills, like pages, help it breathe in water.
tasks.subtitle: Press X-ray to see the book gills — like pages of a book, they help it breathe underwater.

tasks.title: See inside, layer by layer
tasks.hint: Look at the shield, abdomen and book gills
tasks.message: The body has three parts: head shield, abdomen and tail.
tasks.subtitle: Look layer by layer: the head shield, the abdomen, the book gills, and the tail spine.

tasks.title: Protect the mudflats
tasks.hint: Help the horseshoe crab guard its mudflat
tasks.message: The mudflat is the crab's home, and we protect it together.
tasks.subtitle: The horseshoe crab lives on mudflats. If we keep them clean, it can live safely. Thank you!
